title: Community Darkroom
desc: COMING SOON! Our B&W darkroom, located in heart of Manhattan, is equipped for all of your developing and printing needs.

blocks.html:
COMMUNITY DARKROOM

Our B&W darkroom, located in heart of Manhattan, is equipped for all of your developing and printing needs.

Penumbra members receive priority on bookings as well as discounted access. Not a member? Become one today!

Open Thursday - Sunday, 11AM - 9PM

WHAT’S INCLUDED?

  • 6 B&W Enlargers - Ilford Multigrade (35mm through 4x5).

  • Easels and trays, grain focusers, timers, and safelights.

  • Stainless steel sink with temperature controlled water filtration.

  • Drying racks and film drying cabinet with fan & heater.

  • Basic chemistry (we use Sprint but feel free to bring your own).

  • Paterson and stainless steel tanks for developing 35mm and 120 film. Stearman Press SP-445 Compact for 4x5.

    • Other tanks and developing equipment available upon request.

  • Silver recovery unit

*Paper is NOT included.

RESERVE YOUR SPOT!

  • 3 people are allowed to print at once.

  • Max print 11x14 (larger aisles and trays upon request).

  • Members are given priority!

  • Half Day (any block of 4 hours) and Full Day (8 hours) options

  • Member and Non-Member pricing, Members receive significant discounts.
